mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Rebirth</titleLeft><mainText>Anivia reverted to an egg and will soon be reborn!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Anivia reverted to an egg and will soon be reborn!

"Hit the egg! Hit the egg!"

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Egg Timer</titleLeft><mainText>Anivia was recently reborn and must regain her strength.</mainText> <postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Anivia was recently reborn and must regain her strength.
Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia will revert to an egg, receiving @f1@ Armor and Magic Resist, waiting to be reborn.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Upon dying, Anivia will revert into an egg. If the egg can survive, she is gloriously reborn.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg, <healing>healing</healing> to full Health and receiving <scaleArmor>@BonusResists@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>. If she survives for @EggDuration@ seconds, she is reborn.
Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia will revert to an egg, receiving @f1@ Armor and Magic Resist, waiting to be reborn.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Anivia summons an impassable wall of ice @WallWidth@ units wide, blocking all movement. The wall lasts for @WallDuration@ seconds before it melts.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
A massive chunk of ice flies toward target location, dealing @TotalPassthroughDamage@ magic damage and chilling targets, Slowing their Movement Speed by @MovementSpeedMod*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

At the end of its range or if Anivia recasts the spell, the missile detonates, doing @TotalExplosionDamage@ magic damage in a small area and Stunning units for @StunDuration@ second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing a medium amount of damage. If the target has been slowed by an ice effect, the damage they take is doubled.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Anivia blasts her target with a freezing wind, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.  If the target is chilled, they take <magicDamage>@EmpoweredDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Glacial Storm</titleLeft><mainText>Cryophoenix is creating a constant blizzard, draining her Mana each second.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <toggle>Toggle: </toggle>Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> per second and chilling targets, <status>Slowing</status> their Attack and Movement Speed by @SlowAmount@%.
